config.title: FUNDA — Protected Dashboard Shell

intro.title: FUNDA — Protected Dashboard Shell
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Protected Dashboard Shell — an application structure with a public login route and a private dashboard section that requires authentication. A functional canActivate guard checks the auth state and redirects unauthenticated users to the login page with a returnUrl query parameter. A route Resolver pre-fetches the logged-in user's profile before the dashboard renders, eliminating a loading flicker. The dashboard itself is lazy-loaded as a separate bundle that is never downloaded by users who are not authenticated.
intro.usecase: Every enterprise web application has authentication-gated routes. The implementation pattern — guard, resolver, lazy-loaded feature, redirect with returnUrl — is the same across banking portals, SaaS dashboards, admin consoles, and HR platforms.

objectives: Write a functional canActivate guard using inject() that reads auth state from AuthService and redirects to /login with a returnUrl
Configure a lazy-loaded dashboard route using loadChildren pointing to a standalone routes array
Implement a functional ResolveFn that fetches the user profile from the API before the route activates
Access resolved data in the dashboard component via ActivatedRoute.snapshot.data
Read the returnUrl query parameter after successful login and navigate back using safeRedirect validation
Use canMatch to prevent the lazy module bundle from downloading for unauthenticated users
Test the guard using TestBed with a mocked AuthService that returns both logged-in and logged-out states
